segments.exact: We install humidity sensors in all four greenhouse bays before the first frost. Bay two gets the pilot unit first, because it lost the most seedlings last winter.
segments.note: States the rollout plan and pilot-bay rationale; reads as a settled plan statement rather than a directive.

segments.exact: The sensors report every fifteen minutes; anything slower misses the overnight drop.
segments.note: Technical requirement rationale following the agreement.
